cases.title: Transfer text from textarea to content display successfully
cases.description: Verify that inputting text into 'text-area' and clicking 'move-text-button' moves the text to 'content-display', clears the textarea, updates the 'progress-indicator', changes the button background to '#ccc' during the transfer, and reverts it upon completion.

cases.title: Alert handling on empty textarea submission
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'move-text-button' when 'text-area' is empty triggers an alert with the message '请输入文本信息', leaves the content display area empty, and keeps the button background unchanged.

cases.title: Support maximum length and special characters
cases.description: Verify that the application successfully handles text input up to the maximum length of 280 characters including special characters, accurately updating the progress indicator format 'X/Y'.

cases.title: Progress bar and items visual update
cases.description: Verify that the progress bar becomes visible and its items ('progress-bar-item-1' to 'progress-bar-item-6') change color sequentially during the text transfer process.

cases.title: Content display area clearing behavior
cases.description: Verify that the content display area is cleared and reset upon each click of the 'move-text-button' before the new text transfer starts.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases completely cover the requirements, specify distinct scenarios, identify clear and testable risks, and contain no blockers.
All requirements and test cases are aligned, clear, and fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_37-R-1: Testable behaviors include moving text from 'text-area' to 'content-display' via 'move-text-button', clearing the textarea, triggering an alert with message '请输入文本信息' when the textarea is empty, supporting up to 280 characters including special characters, updating the 'progress-indicator', changing progress bar items ('progress-bar-item-1' to 'progress-bar-item-6') colors sequentially, and changing the button background to '#ccc' during transfer and reverting after. Boundaries: empty input vs 1 to 280 characters. Abnormal paths: empty textarea click. Ambiguities: exact timing and sequential color mapping logic for the 6 progress bar items relative to arbitrary text lengths.

e2edev_bench_37-R-3: Testable behaviors include mapping elements via data-testid and id attributes ('text-area'/'text', 'content-display'/'content', 'move-text-button'/'button', 'progress-indicator', 'progress-bar'), showing alert '请输入文本信息' on empty submission, button background change to '#ccc', progress bar visibility, character-by-character transfer updating the strong element in progress indicator to 'X/Y' format, sequential progress item color changes, handling special characters up to 280 length. Boundaries: max 280 characters, empty state. Abnormal paths: clicking button with empty textarea.

e2edev_bench_37-R-4: Testable behaviors include changing button background color to '#ccc' upon valid non-empty click, keeping color unchanged and displaying alert '请输入文本信息' when empty. Boundaries: empty vs non-empty textarea. Abnormal paths: empty textarea click.

e2edev_bench_37-R-6: Testable behaviors include clearing 'content-display' upon each valid button click and ensuring it stays empty on invalid empty clicks along with the '请输入文本信息' alert. Boundaries: empty vs non-empty textarea state during click. Abnormal paths: clicking with empty textarea.
